webPush.explain: To remind you, cichlids sends a message through the push service of your browser's maker (Google, Mozilla, Microsoft or Apple). That service learns that this browser receives notifications from cichlids.com, and when, but not what they say. You can switch this off at any time, which deletes the subscription on our server. Your browser asks for permission next.

vacation.privacy: An active vacation stays private. Once it has ended, it is shown with your streaks, and your profile shows how much time you spent on vacation.
